# The Protection of the Occupants in the Event of a Frontal Collision for Motor Vehicles

**Regulated Area:** Frontal impact

**Applicability:** Applies to passenger vehicles when the GB standard scope includes M1/passenger cars or road motor vehicles; verify mandatory vs recommended status and implementation date.


## Key Compliance Intent

Maintain occupant survival space and manage crash energy in full, offset, or full-width frontal crashes.

## Primary Vehicle Systems and Components

Front rails, bumper beam, crush cans, dash/cowl, pedals, steering column, airbags, belts, seats, sensors, firewall.

## Failure Modes and Symptoms

Excessive HIC/chest/femur loads, excessive pedal or steering intrusion, airbag timing errors, dash intrusion, door jamming after crash.

## Related Regulations

FMVSS/CMVSS 208; UNECE R94/R137; GB 11551 and GB/T 20913; KMVSS Arts. 102/102-3; ADR 69/73; CONTRAN 910; GSO 36/40; Japan Article 18.

## Engineering Considerations

Mandatory GB for frontal collision occupant protection; check upcoming revisions and type-approval transition dates.

# Strength of Passenger Car Seats and Seat Fasteners

**Regulated Area:** Restraints / seats / child protection

**Applicability:** Seats, tracks, anchors, head restraints, recliners, fasteners, trim integration Retained under broad-scope review so the program team can manually disposition applicability.


## Key Compliance Intent

Keep occupants and child restraints correctly positioned and restrained during crash and normal driving.

## Primary Vehicle Systems and Components

Seats, head restraints, seat tracks, recliners, belt assemblies, retractors, pretensioners, buckles, anchorages, ISOFIX/LATCH/tether hardware.

## Failure Modes and Symptoms

Seat belt anchorage failure, belt webbing/retractor malfunction, poor belt fit, child restraint mis-installation, seat track release, excessive head excursion.

## Related Regulations

Possible functional overlap: GB / China GB 15083-2019 - Strength Requirement and Test Method of Automobile Seats, Their Anchorages and Any Head Restraints

## Engineering Considerations

Regional passenger/light-vehicle coverage; confirm exact applicability by vehicle category, model year, fuel/propulsion type, and local type-approval route.

# Road Vehicle - Vehicle Identification Number (VIN)

**Regulated Area:** Certification / traceability / recall readiness

**Applicability:** Applies to road vehicles in China, including passenger vehicles, for VIN content and identification requirements.


## Key Compliance Intent

Standardize VIN identification for registration, traceability, recalls and enforcement.

## Primary Vehicle Systems and Components

VIN marking, vehicle identification plate, body/frame marking, ECU/build records, recall population database.

## Failure Modes and Symptoms

Duplicate VIN; invalid VIN structure; marking unreadable; VIN mismatch between vehicle and documents; recall or registration population error.

## Related Regulations

49 CFR Part 565; ISO 3779/3780; CMVSS/MVSR VIN; ADR/RAV VIN; Japan/Korea VIN requirements.

## Engineering Considerations

Added because passenger-vehicle traceability standards belong in the revised scope.
